protocol.maskPolicy: Union of GUI residual-movement highlights across the precomputed keyframes relative to the first layout; attached-tree/chain grouping retained.
protocol.timeParameter: linear in target aspect ratio; computed layouts at 0.1 AR intervals

nodeSizing.scope: presentation symbols only; same keyframe sizes in both conditions; optimizer positions unchanged

protocol.edgeInterpolation: linear interpolation of corresponding GUI route samples between adjacent keyframes; baseline uses direct straight edge chords
